sources.title: Security exception applicability and lifecycle
sources.note: Retain the merged exception approval, lifecycle and private-envelope governance. Technical enforcement remains SEC-004 in engineering standards; the generic legacy standards entry does not supersede this explicit authority.

sources.title: Security exception approver registry
sources.note: Retain the canonical approval-role registry. A candidate catalogue does not alter its members or authorise an exception.

sources.title: Free Security Gate baseline and enrollment decision
sources.note: Preserve the merged no-paid-GHAS baseline and evidence-before-enrollment decision. Migrate overlapping technical requirements through coordinated review, never by silently weakening the existing baseline.

sources.title: Public non-sensitive exception authority envelopes
sources.note: Retain the existing public authority-envelope mechanism. Validity still requires current provider approvals, unrevoked scope, private decision digest and time boundaries; the catalogue does not grant acceptance.

external_surfaces.surface: Notion Mallow Standards and engineering guidance
external_surfaces.rule: Render or link versioned sources; retain source status and verification date. Do not independently edit normative requirements.

external_surfaces.surface: Organisation discussions, issues and decision proposals
external_surfaces.rule: Record proposals and rationale; adopted requirements must resolve to a canonical control and approved release.

external_surfaces.surface: Repository README, CONTRIBUTING, AGENTS, agent-specific instructions and local configuration
external_surfaces.rule: Declare repository-specific facts and approved stricter requirements; reference the canonical profile and release instead of copying organisation rules.
Skills execute applicable policy; capability visibility and instructions do not prove approval, installation or current enforcement.

external_surfaces.surface: Live GitHub rulesets, classic protection, environments and provider settings
external_surfaces.rule: Prove actual enforcement. Reconcile drift explicitly; do not automatically treat observed state as approved desired state.
Retain approved execution scope, source-bound evidence and recovery state privately. They do not independently redefine policy.

external_surfaces.surface: SharePoint locked records, Library exports and historic chats
external_surfaces.rule: Retain dated context and supersession. Do not prefer a copied document over its canonical current source.
